Docs.param: The frequency of the recurrence (daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly).
The interval between recurrences of the specified frequency.

param.name: days
param.para: The days of the week on which the event recurs.

param.name: monthDays
param.para: The days of the month on which the event recurs (values from -31 to 31, excluding 0).

param.name: months
param.para: The months of the year in which the event recurs (values from 1 to 12).

param.name: weeksOfTheYear
param.para: The weeks of the year in which the event recurs (values from -53 to 53, excluding 0).

param.name: daysOfTheYear
param.para: The days of the year on which the event recurs (values from -366 to 366, excluding 0).

param.name: setPositions
param.para: The positions within the recurrence set to filter results (values from -366 to 366, excluding 0).

param.name: end
param.para: The end condition for the recurrence rule.

Docs.summary: Creates a recurrence rule with the specified frequency, interval, and recurrence constraints.
